Canonical section evaluation at valuation-ring centers gives norms in [0,1] and the trivial reference metric. Rational PL functions form a vector lattice uniformly dense in C0(Xan).

BJ 7.7-7.8 give concave translation-equivariant energy, the genuine finite-energy cone, mixed finiteness and normalization energy compatibility. These statements do not require smoothness or EP.

premises.statement: For a reduced projective variety over an algebraically closed trivially valued field and ample omega, BJ 8.2-8.8 define outer energy, continuous on decreasing USC nets and equal to genuine energy on psh; under EP it equals energy of the genuine envelope. For fixed real PL f, its expansion at any actual E1 potential is E_down(phi+tf)=E(phi)+t integral(f MA_BJ(phi))+O(t^2), uniformly in phi. Both signed continuous directions follow by uniform PL approximation. No smoothness hypothesis enters these global derivative theorems.

BJ 9.9 gives USC outer-energy duality, and 9.11-9.12 identify a genuinely attained E1 maximizer with its actual Monge-Ampere equation, using f and -f and PL density. No inverse-support operator or EP is assumed in this identification.

BJ 9.20 says finite intrinsic dual energy is equivalent to integrability of all actual E1 potentials. General finite-energy concavity, I/J and scaling estimates used here are those of 7.28-7.33. No smoothness or support condition is imposed.

premises.statement: On a reduced projective variety over an algebraically closed trivially valued field with ample omega, BJ 7.40-7.44 give genuine unbounded E1 strict-winning Borel locality, mixed open locality and comparison. On an equidimensional projective variety, 10.3-10.6 give equality of genuine MA iff I=0 iff the potential difference is locally constant, and domination of a psh potential by an E1 potential when the inequality holds almost everywhere for its MA. These theorems require neither smoothness nor EP; irreducibility makes the difference one constant.

Its EP-to-surjectivity proof obtains an actual normalized psh subnet limit using general EP compactness, bounded J, target integral continuity and energy USC to attain the variational supremum. premises.statement: For a projective scheme of dimension n over a complete valued field and actual rational semiample bundles, BE 1805.01016v3 7.14 makes FS-limit metrics psh-regularizable on the same bundles. Its 8.3-8.5 construct positive continuous mixed Radon measures of raw fundamental-cycle intersection mass, uniform continuity and complete-field pushforward. The full fundamental cycle includes generic lengths. BE 8.18-8.21 identify model Deligne pairing and vertical intersections, including the zero-dimensional induction and relatively regular section proof. BJ 7.23 identifies this continuous operator with its energy-pairing operator.
